# Know Meet — KBD Constraints

Project-specific rules for KBD verification. Derived from the generic KBD
template plus Know Meet conventions. The repository has no `AGENTS.md` yet, so
there is no "Never Do" section to import. Revisit this file when the hybrid
shell workspace adds one.

Build, test and lint commands are not defined yet (see `project.json`). Until
the hybrid shell phase sets them, `build-passes` and `no-lint-warnings` are
checked against the commands that phase introduces.

---

## Blocking constraints

```yaml
constraints:
  - id: no-livekit-secrets-in-repo
    severity: blocking
    description: 'LIVEKIT_API_SECRET / LIVEKIT_API_KEY values never appear in tracked files; they come from the shell environment only'
    check: "git grep --untracked -nE 'LIVEKIT_API_(SECRET|KEY)\\s*[:=]\\s*[\"\\x27]?[A-Za-z0-9]{16,}' -- . ':!*.md'"

  - id: no-hardcoded-secrets
    severity: blocking
    description: 'No hardcoded API keys, tokens or passwords in source'
    check: "git grep --untracked -nE '(sk-[A-Za-z0-9]{20,}|api_key\\s*=\\s*[\"\\x27][A-Za-z0-9]{12,})' -- apps packages docs/design/live"

  - id: token-secret-stays-server-side
    severity: blocking
    description: 'Browser, Tauri webview and Flutter client code never receive the LiveKit API secret; tokens are minted server-side'
    note: 'Manual review of any token / auth change'

  - id: design-tokens-single-source
    severity: blocking
    description: 'Brand colors, type and spacing come from the Know Meet design tokens (docs/design/tokens.css / tokens.json); no ad-hoc hex values in app UI code'
    note: 'Applies to React, Tauri and Flutter themes; Flutter theme must be generated from or mirror tokens.json'

  - id: reference-repo-read-only
    severity: blocking
    description: '/Users/gqadonis/Projects/hybrid-mobile-architecture-src is a read-only reference; never write to it from this project'

  - id: max-500-lines-per-file
    severity: blocking
    description: 'No authored file exceeds 500 lines in any language; oversized files become a feature directory split by clean-architecture layer (see AGENTS.md)'
    exceptions: 'lockfiles; generated code (*.g.dart, *.freezed.dart, routeTree.gen.ts, frb output, src-tauri/gen/**); vendored code (**/vendor/**); native platform project files; test fixtures/goldens; tool-generated AI-harness skill/command files under .agents|.claude|.codex|.dsh|.kimi-code|.opencode|.qwen|.zed; docs/design/prototype/** and docs/design/live/** (E-L6, operator 2026-11-09); CHANGELOG.md'
    note: 'Checker script to be added to lint, pre-commit and CI in this phase'

  - id: kebab-case-file-names
    severity: blocking
    description: 'File and directory names are kebab-case'
    exceptions: 'Dart *.dart lower_snake_case; Rust module files snake_case; tool-mandated names (README.md, LICENSE, CHANGELOG.md, AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, Cargo.toml, build.rs, main.rs, lib.rs, mod.rs, pubspec.yaml, package.json, tsconfig*.json, vite.config.ts, components.json, tauri.conf.json, Dockerfile, dotfiles); native platform scaffolding; generator-owned names; tool-generated AI-harness files (SKILL.md, command files, .openspec-target) under harness dot-directories'

  - id: no-any-type
    severity: blocking
    description: 'No `any` type in TypeScript source'
    check: "git grep -nE ':\\s*any\\b' -- '*.ts' '*.tsx'"

  - id: build-passes
    severity: blocking
    description: 'Project build must pass without errors'
    command: '<see .kbd-orchestrator/project.json build_health_command>'
```

---

## Warning constraints

```yaml
  - id: design-prototype-fidelity
    severity: warning
    description: 'Shell UI matches the reference prototype (docs/design/prototype, docs/design/live) in look, feel and both themes'
    note: 'Visual comparison at 375 / 768 / 1024 / 1440 in light and dark'

  - id: shadcn-components-not-forked-ad-hoc
    severity: warning
    description: 'UI primitives come from the shared shadcn/ui component set themed with Know Meet tokens, not one-off copies per app'

  - id: clean-architecture-boundaries
    severity: warning
    description: 'Domain and application layers do not import UI, Tauri, Flutter or LiveKit SDK code; adapters live at the edge'

  - id: no-console-log-in-commits
    severity: warning
    description: 'No console.log in committed TypeScript/JavaScript application code'
    check: "git grep -n 'console\\.log' -- '*.ts' '*.tsx'"

  - id: tests-for-new-features
    severity: warning
    description: 'Tests exist for new features added in a change'

  - id: no-stub-comments
    severity: warning
    description: 'No TODO/FIXME/STUB/HACK comments in committed code'

  - id: accessibility-basics
    severity: warning
    description: 'New UI has semantic HTML or accessible names, visible focus, and reduced-motion support'
```

## Path ownership

- `docs/design/prototype/` and `docs/design/live/` are design references. Shell
  work reads them; changes there are design changes, not shell changes.
- `live/` at the repo root is a stale duplicate of `docs/design/live/`. It is
  pending removal and must not be used as a source.

# PLAN: hybrid-shell-foundation

- **Project:** know-meet
- **Date:** 2026-11-09
- **OpenSpec available:** YES (1.16.1, managed runner)
- **Changes to implement:** 14
- **Contract:** `.kbd-orchestrator/phases/hybrid-shell-foundation/adopted-contract.json`, sha256 `f91e7c30ac98e27256e4b6d4bcbf4b630760061580f65cd3b923b07b86d786c9`, planRevision 1, decision `contract-adoption-hybrid-shell-foundation-f91e7c30`
- **Inputs:** `assessment.md`, `analysis.md`, `library-candidates.json`, the operator decisions in `decision-log.md` (2026-11-09), `AGENTS.md`, and `.agent-team/know-meet-team/team.json`

## Recalled lessons that change this plan

- *"The hybrid-mobile-architecture package … also supplies skills worth binding: design tokens, UI fidelity, Flutter goldens, accessibility gate, sync doctrine and dependency pinning."* The changes below bind each of those skills to the role that uses them.
- Reference-repo lesson (`knowme-ui-failure-analysis.md`): a UI that passed the architecture checks still wasn't a real product. **Value scenarios and prototype baselines are therefore defined in c03, before any screen is generated.** Fidelity is judged by screenshots against the prototype, not structure.
- Package pitfall: an unguarded Tauri call blanks the plain web build. **VS-5 is a required scenario**, and the `isTauri()` guards are part of c06.

## Operator decisions this plan implements

- **Keep everything the generator produces.** That covers Rust core, flutter_rust_bridge, the Axum BFF, UAR and PEM. Restructuring is limited to three things: merging the duplicated web and desktop React apps into one bundle, kebab-case and 500-line compliance, and mapping onto the four clean-architecture layers.
- **Token values:** what the prototype renders, reconciled into `docs/design/tokens.json`, which stays hand-edited.
- **Token generator:** the package's generator, vendored into this repo and extended.
- **Screen scope:** the app frame plus static home, sign-in, join, dashboard, agents, recordings and settings screens, and the meeting-room layout with media stubbed.
- **500-line exceptions:** the frozen design prototypes are exempt; long docs follow the rule; `CHANGELOG.md` is exempt.

## Trade-offs and scope cuts (surfaced, not hidden)

- **Root `live/` blocks the 500-line check.** It's a stale duplicate of `docs/design/live/` holding files of up to 3,415 lines, and the adopted exemption covers only `docs/design/prototype/**` and `docs/design/live/**`. Recommended: delete it in c01 (task 1.6). Awaiting the operator's answer; the alternative is a temporary exception.

- **"Keep everything" widens this phase.** The Axum BFF, UAR and PEM come in and have to build (VS-9), even though no in-scope screen uses them. That adds build surface and risk; c05 owns it.
- **Ownership gap.** Generator output for `crates/**`, `services/bff/**` and the generator's `uar` folders has **no owner** in `team.json`. The delivery lead must assign it before c05 runs (task 5.0). Proposed owners: architect for `crates/**`, build-platform for `services/bff/**`.
- **Deferred:** Windows and Linux desktop builds, physical-device testing, and interactive flows on the in-scope screens (contract `deferredOptional`).
- **Version drift:** this phase uses the `versions.toml` pins. Installed rustc 1.99.1, tauri-cli 2.10.0, pnpm 11.25.0 and Flutter 3.48 beta are realigned in c01. The generator must be reinstalled at alpha.5 before c05.

1. **c01-workspace-and-repo-rules:** pnpm workspace, toolchain pins and enforced repo rules.
   - Scope: tooling / CI. Depends on: NONE. Owner role: build-platform. Library: cand-003, cand-010, cand-015, cand-016.
